pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit sequential entries (such as tickets 2123013996 and 2123016852) within a 5-minute window on the same asset to avoid pyramiding into falling knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require an instantaneous ATR-normalized volatility filter and an order-book imbalance check before executing any order, bypassing trades during spread expansions.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing profit lock-ins once a position reaches +$10.00 to prevent floating gains from evaporating into negative territory.
